decision.GO: at least two datasets have valid matched Empty/Nominal/PESS held-out measurements and reproducible nontrivial descriptive decision differences or effective-MCV mechanisms, without universal dominance claims
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: required data, cohort size, group independence, source trace, sample identity, or measurement validity is insufficient; also applies to any fail-closed run
decision.NO-GO: the tested physical contrast is falsified or no nontrivial contrast is observed under the supported workloads, with valid measurement fidelity
scientific_boundary: proxy budget is not generic or physical maintenance

measurement_contract.candidate_costs: 1 proxy unit per predeclared pairwise MCV object
measurement_contract.creation_order: protocol candidate order, unchanged for every set
measurement_contract.invalid_policy: missing/ambiguous trace, nonpositive pre-clamp estimate, unmapped selected OID, missing catalog ledger, sample identity mismatch, or hash mismatch makes the affected run INVALID and blocks a GO claim; never silently drop a query
measurement_contract.latency: not collected; no latency or physical maintenance-cost claim
paired_comparisons: PESS vs Nominal when both are defined
measurement_contract.preclamp_metric: |ln(estimate/max(1,N))| only when measured positive pre-clamp estimate is positive
measurement_contract.query_order: dataset order forest10 then census13; within each dataset calibration first, then budget ascending and method order Empty/Nominal/PESS, then frozen test source_index order
measurement_contract.sample: one Issue-48-owned fixed sample per dataset, exported after import and replayed before every statistics ANALYZE; hash and relation identity recorded before held-out measurements
secondary_metrics: tail diagnostics only if predeclared from validation-free test truth after measurement

model_selection.calibration_order: calibrate all candidates and Empty on the frozen validation records before opening the test workload
model_selection.coefficient_definition: alpha=ln(n0/T), b_e=ln(n_e/n0) from validation-only positive pre-clamp estimates; model arithmetic is exact only after explicitly recorded rationalization

methods.Nominal: minimize validation task-wise loss under the fixed candidate creation order greedy maximal-matching policy
methods.PESS: minimize sum of validation task-wise maxima over all maximal matchings permitted by the frozen candidate graph

model_selection.solver_boundary: Fraction reference certificates are exact for recorded rationalized inputs; floating-point solver optimality is not upgraded to exact certification
model_selection.tie_policy: retain every optimal set; selected execution set is lexicographically smallest only as a deterministic representative, and duplicate selected sets across budgets remain separate aliases
